This batch therefore emphasizes intermediate condition curves and high-width representatives from common failure regions, while retaining a few matched loading contrasts.","batch_rationale":"The batch concentrates labels where the current predictor can learn conditional structure rather than simply more low-retention baselines. m72, m216, and m211 form nitrogen response curves across ratio, solvent, and loading. m13, m94, m107, m125, and m159 probe delayed V2 tails and intermediate transitions supported by measured failures. The m177 point tests a particularly informative ratio contrast at matched loading. Six additional high-width rows from m78, m90, m37, m53, m204, and m135 repair broader failure regions represented in the Row-distribution. Together these experiments discriminate shared versus topology-specific corrections and should improve both endpoint accuracy and generalization without optimizing the chromatographic conditions themselves."}
